t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to match the colour of the basket to the colour of the gnomes. When the number of musrooms collected starts to reduce switch gnomes then repeat.

vb_textbox.text: There are two sets of three gnomes. Purple, pink and brown correspond to the brown basket, green, yellow and blue to the yelow basket. If you can select the gnome that matches its basket the payout seems to be  a bit higher. It reduces after a while so switch to the other group of gnomes
